name: Metalcraft Calendar
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools to read and manage a user's calendars via Metalcraft Calendar (calendar.metalcraftai.com). One Metalcraft account can own many calendars, each addressed by a slug and carrying a required IANA timezone: list calendars, list events by day (today/tomorrow/YYYY-MM-DD, resolved in the calendar's timezone) or time window, get an event, create/update/delete events (needs the write scope), and pull the latest from a linked Google calendar. Authenticated by a single Metalcraft account token — METALCRAFT_TOKEN, sent as Authorization: Bearer — the same token that works across every Metalcraft ecosystem app. The API base is fixed to https://calendar.metalcraftai.com.
